# HP_SWTOOLS_DRIVER.sys ![:inline](/images/twitter_verified.png) 

### Description

HP_SWTOOLS_DRIVER exposes privileged CPU and memory operations through the \\.\HP_WKS_SWTOOLS_DRIVER device. Static analysis confirms IOCTLs for MSR read and write, performance-counter access, physical/MMIO mapping and read/write, PCI configuration access, port I/O, and a CPU-halt path. A standard user can reach the device after an administrator installs the driver.
- **UUID**: 19f13965-7078-4c19-a2e3-71ab8b77a9b7
- **Created**: 2026-08-29
- **Author**: Faxs
- **Acknowledgement**: Faxs | [@10fax01](https://twitter.com/@10fax01)

### Commands

```
sc.exe create HP_SWTOOLS_DRIVER binPath= C:\windows\temp\HP_SWTOOLS_DRIVER.sys type= kernel &amp;&amp; sc.exe start HP_SWTOOLS_DRIVER
```


| Use Case | Privileges | Operating System | 
|:---- | ---- | ---- |
| Read or modify privileged CPU state and physical memory from user mode. | Administrator required to install; device access is available to standard users after installation | Windows 10, Windows 11 |
